subject: Request: short extension + sandbox credits for on‑prem connector delay (RetailSense)
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@retailsense.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief extension — on‑prem connector build slowed by infra changes

Diego,

Appreciate the quick demo earlier this week — Tom and I walked the team through the integration checklist yesterday. Our infra team hit an unexpected blocker: the on‑prem SFTP gateway we planned to use is being migrated this week, so our engineering sprint for the connector is delayed by ~8 business days.

We really want to validate Redwood in our staging environment (LLM+embedding flows) before committing, but the migration pushed our window out of the existing trial expiry. Is it possible to: 1) extend our trial by two weeks and 2) provision an extra 50k sandbox credit so our infra and ML teams can run full end‑to‑end tests once the gateway is back online?

I can share the migration schedule and a short note from our infra lead if that helps. We’d like to keep the momentum — Tom is keen on the vendor decision process finishing this quarter.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Head of Integrations, RetailSense
emily.chen@retailsense.com
+1 (415) 555‑0192

Marissa / Monica — forwarding RetailSense’s ask. They’re mid‑POC, good fit, and this is an infra migration (not product blocker). Ask: +2 weeks trial and +50k sandbox credit.

Monica — can CS accept a two‑week extension and the extra sandbox pool? If so I’ll propose a conditional approval (extend now, credits on confirmation of staging runs).

Marissa — I’d like to keep this under $X of free credits; if you want to approve more, please chime in. Customer is time‑sensitive (decision Q2).

Emily — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the integration log. We can run the smoke checklist remotely and validate once your gateway migration completes. Steps we need you to confirm during the extension window:

- Complete on‑prem gateway migration and confirm endpoint URL (point 1 in attached checklist)
- Deploy the connector container to staging and run the embedding ingest test (two small datasets)
- Share staging logs and a short recording of model responses for the SMOKE_TEST email thread

Once we see those deliverables we’ll apply the promo code RS-TRIAL-50K to your staging account and keep the trial active for two additional weeks. If you want, Diego can do a short sync with your infra lead to accelerate the smoke validation.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
